summary: Atomic bounded editorial review recording avoids full-site serialization per page after a verified business-context update
evidence: content-studio/src/model.mjs recordEditorialReview reads and rewrites one full site per page; current Promedical contact change invalidates 1856 context-bound reviews
rollback: Scoped revert of batch API, CLI entry and documentation; individual review recorder remains supported and immutable approvals are preserved
